thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: CRITICAL hosted-inference-queue-saturated (service: hosted-runtime) for customer acme-corp. Paging primary on-call @aj and secondary @katie. Incident link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-98765 :rotating_light:

aj: ack - seeing it now, will check queue size.

incident-bot: Escalation: primary did not acknowledge within 90s, notifying secondary @katie and manager @mike-manager.

katie: ack. grabbing logs and taking lead. can someone pull the task queue length and recent 5xx count?

sanjay: looking. via metrics: hosted-runtime.queue.length=~4200 (normal <200), 5xx rate increased from 0.1% -> 8% over last 5m. error traces show OOM when allocating kv cache on g4dn-pool-2.

katie: thanks. @aj @sanjay any recent deploys to hosted-runtime?

aj: no deploys in last 2 hours. nothing from release pipeline. I've got a quick workaround: scale up dedicated pool and reroute heavy customers (acme-corp) to fallback-model-1 to reduce token cost. preparing commands.

sanjay: agree. runbook suggests two options: 1) drain queue and scale pool, 2) enable per-customer throttling. scaling + reroute fastest.

katie: go for 1. aj, paste the exact commands you will run so we can audit.

aj: running:```bash
# scale up GPU pool
rdrctl pools scale --name g4dn-pool-2 --replicas 6
# mark acme traffic to fallback model
rdrctl routes update --customer acme-corp --model fallback-model-1
```

incident-bot: Deploy/scale action logged: action_id=act-3312 by aj. PD incident updated.

pagerduty-bot: Manager escalation triggered - notifying @mike-manager (no response required unless escalated further).

katie: monitoring metrics now. 2m after scale command: queue.length -> 900, 5xx -> 3%. still high but trending down.

sanjay: logs: a subset of inferences hitting long prompt combos causing KV memory blowup. we've pushed a limiter to request size in the gateway for acme-corp:```json
{"request_limit_tokens": 4096}
```

aj: limiter applied. also restarting a few noisy hosts to reclaim memory: ```bash
rdrctl hosts restart --pool g4dn-pool-2 --filter "age>6h" --grace 30
```

katie: good. looks like 5xx back to 0.6% after 8m, queue.length steady ~120. customer requests still served via fallback-model-1, latency increased ~30% but error rate near zero.

mike-manager: thanks all. any customer-facing impact? do we need to page account team?

katie: acme-corp saw ~12% of requests failing for ~7m before reroute. Post-mitigation success rate 99.3%. recommended: notify AEs with short summary + apology and note remediation and planned postmortem.

aj: creating incident ticket and will draft customer note. also making a follow-up task: tighten PD escalation threshold for hosted runtime to 60s and add runbook steps for immediate reroute.

incident-bot: PD incident PD-98765 marked: mitigated -> monitoring.

katie: marking this thread resolved for on-call work. follow-ups: (1) postmortem scheduled, (2) add automatic per-customer request-size limiter to edge, (3) add autoscale buffer for g4dn-pool-2. I'll add todos in the incident ticket.

aj: thumbs up. closing out handoff. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-98765 closed by katie.

mike-manager: small ask - please add estimated cost impact of fallback routing and any SLA credit exposure to the ticket.

katie: will do. thanks team.

sanjay: note for postmortem: reproduce locally with long-prefix prompts + kv-cache stress test. I'll start a repro run and post results in the ticket.

aj: added runbook link: https://docs.redwood/incident-runbooks/hosted-runtime-reroute

katie: OK closing thread. great response time once secondary picked up. we'll refine primary availability and escalation windows.
